AGILITY.about: Early levels can be skipped by completing quests that give Agility experience.
AGILITY.name: Questing

AGILITY.about: Brimhaven Agility Arena offers the fastest experience from level 20 to 47. Players must have 200 coins to pay the entry fee for the course.
AGILITY.name: Brimhaven Agility Arena

AGILITY.about: The Wilderness Agility Course offers the fastest experience rates from level 47 to 62. Level 52 is normally required to enter the course, but this can be boosted from level 47 with a summer pie.
AGILITY.name: Wilderness Agility Course

AGILITY.about: The Hallowed Sepulchre offers the fastest experience from level 62 onwards. In the Sepulchre, the player will need to run through each floor while avoiding various traps.
AGILITY.name: Hallowed Sepulchre

AGILITY.about: After completion of The Blood Moon Rises you can mix other activities with the Rockslide (Vampyrium) shortcut which grants 550 experience every ~7.5 minutes.
AGILITY.name: Rockslide + Other Activities

AGILITY.about: Rooftop Agility Courses are slower but straightforward and less attention-intensive alternatives to the faster training methods. While training on one of the rooftop courses, there is a chance of finding a Mark of Grace.
AGILITY.name: Rooftop Agility Courses

AGILITY.about: Repeatedly crossing the monkeybar shortcut in the Edgeville Dungeon offers up to 13,200 experience per hour. With the right camera angle, it is possible to keep the mouse cursor in one spot and continuously click.
AGILITY.name: Edgeville Dungeon monkeybars

AGILITY.about: Barbarian Fishing grants small amounts of passive Agility and Strength experience. Levelling Fishing from level 58 to 99 by Barbarian Fishing would get the player from level 30 Agility to 74.
AGILITY.name: Barbarian Fishing

AGILITY.about: The Agility Pyramid is a straightforward, profitable method of training Agility with little requirements.
AGILITY.name: Agility Pyramid

AGILITY.about: The Brimhaven Agility Arena offers a different approach to training Agility.
AGILITY.name: Brimhaven Agility Arena

AGILITY.about: The Ape Atoll Agility Course is a viable alternative for players who have completed chapter 2 of Monkey Madness I. To access this course, players must wear a ninja monkey greegree (either variant will work) or a Kruk greegree.
AGILITY.name: Ape Atoll Agility Course

AGILITY.about: The Shayzien Advanced Agility Course is an alternative for players who cannot access the Ape Atoll Agility Course or do not wish to train on the Wilderness Agility Course. Completing this course requires a crossbow and a mith grapple.
AGILITY.name: Shayzien Advanced Agility Course

AGILITY.about: The Colossal Wyrm Agility Course is a less click-intensive course that offers an alternative way to get Amylase crystals.
AGILITY.name: Colossal Wyrm Agility Course

AGILITY.about: The Werewolf Agility Course is an alternative for those who seek for both decent experience rates and marks of grace. To access this course, players must have completed Creature of Fenkenstrain and wear a Ring of Charos.
AGILITY.name: Werewolf Agility Course

AGILITY.about: The Prifddinas Agility Course offers a less click-intensive training option from level 75 onwards, being similar to the Rooftop Agility Courses. Players must have completed Song of the Elves to access this course.
AGILITY.name: Prifddinas Agility Course

ATTACK.about: As discussed in the above early questing section, completing quests is the fastest method to skip through the early levels. These quests will level a player to level 45 Attack, level 34 Strength, and level 31 Defence without any direct training.
ATTACK.name: Questing

CONSTRUCTION.about: The table below shows the furniture and materials needed to reach level 33. Be sure to bring a saw and a hammer in order to make furniture.
CONSTRUCTION.name: Starting off

CONSTRUCTION.about: From level 33 to 52, build oak larders in the Kitchen. Oak larders require 8 oak planks to build, and they grant 480 experience each.
CONSTRUCTION.name: Oak larders

CONSTRUCTION.about: Building mahogany furniture becomes the fastest viable training method at level 52. It is very expensive, so look into cheaper alternatives (such as teak or oak furniture) if trying to save money.
CONSTRUCTION.name: Mahogany furniture

CONSTRUCTION.about: Mahogany Homes is a cheaper and less click-intensive alternative to the faster methods.
CONSTRUCTION.name: Mahogany Homes

CONSTRUCTION.about: Boat repair kits and hull parts can be constructed at a shipwrights' workbench near a bank and resold to other players, which is different from most other Construction training methods which use resources without producing items.
CONSTRUCTION.name: Shipwrights' workbench

CONSTRUCTION.about: Mounted mythical capes are a cheaper alternative to mahogany or other teak furniture. They require 3 teak planks each along with a mythical cape. The cape is returned after removing the furniture.
CONSTRUCTION.name: Mounted mythical capes

CONSTRUCTION.about: Building teak garden benches is the fastest way to use teak planks. They require 6 teak planks to build and give 540 experience each. This method is similar to gnome benches, offering slower (albeit still relatively fast) experience while being cheaper.
CONSTRUCTION.name: Teak garden benches

CONSTRUCTION.about: Building oak doors is a cheaper and less click-intensive alternative to mahogany or teak furniture. Building an oak door requires 10 oak planks and grants 600 Construction experience.
CONSTRUCTION.name: Oak doors

CONSTRUCTION.about: Repairing fishing cranes in Port Piscarilius is a low-intensity, click-light training method for both Construction and Crafting, available from level 30 in both skills.
CONSTRUCTION.name: Fishing crane repair

COOKING.about: From level 1 to 30, 1-tick cook raw karambwan into poison karambwan. Karambwan can be cooked without tick delay by holding down 1 and rapidly using raw karambwan on a fire or range.
COOKING.name: Poison karambwan

COOKING.about: Alternatively, cook various fish for early experience. This is slower than cooking poison karambwan, but cheaper and less click-intensive.
COOKING.name: Cooking fish

COOKING.about: Completion of the quest Tai Bwo Wannai Trio is required to successfully cook karambwan.
COOKING.name: Cooked karambwan

COOKING.about: Completion of the quest Lunar Diplomacy is required to cast Bake Pie.
COOKING.name: Bake Pie

COOKING.about: Making jugs of wine offers fast experience, though requires more attention than cooking fish or casting Bake Pie.
COOKING.name: Jug of wine

COOKING.about: Cooking various fish is a cheap or profitable low-effort alternative to the faster methods. Cooking an inventory of fish takes around 1 minute and 14 seconds in the Hosidius Kitchen, including banking.
COOKING.name: Cooking fish

CRAFTING.about: From level 1 to 20, craft the highest-level leather item available. Leather currently costs  each and all items only require one leather to craft. In order to craft any leather items, you need a needle and some thread.
CRAFTING.name: Leather items

CRAFTING.about: Cutting (uncut) gems offers the fastest experience up to level 77. However, cutting dragonstones is much more expensive compared to the lower-level gems, so it is recommended to keep cutting diamonds until level 62 and continue with fire battlestaves.
CRAFTING.name: Cutting gems

CRAFTING.about: Crafting battlestaves offers relatively fast experience and is usually cheaper compared to other methods. While this method is usually relatively cheap, buying the supplies requires a lot of capital.
CRAFTING.name: Battlestaves

CRAFTING.about: Crafting d'hide bodies becomes the fastest viable training method from level 77 onwards. Players can begin crafting green d'hide bodies at level 63, or blue d'hide bodies at level 71 as an alternative method to cutting gems or crafting battlestaves.
CRAFTING.name: D'hide bodies

CRAFTING.about: Blowing molten glass with a glassblowing pipe offers very slow experience rates, but it requires little attention and a low amount of capital.
CRAFTING.name: Molten glass

CRAFTING.about: Starting at level 5, players can begin crafting gold jewellery using a gold bar and the appropriate mould at a furnace. The type of jewellery crafted depends on the mould used, with rings, necklaces, amulets, and bracelets being the primary options.
CRAFTING.name: Crafting jewellery

CRAFTING.about: With the addition of Sailing, raw materials can be spun into balls of yarn and further woven into bolts of fabric for crafting experience and in some cases, a small profit. Fossil island features both a spinning wheel and a loom near a bank.
CRAFTING.name: Spinning and weaving yarn

CRAFTING.about: Drift nets can be crafted from 2 jute fibre each. About 1,000 can be made per hour for 60,000 experience per hour and  coins per hour when using the loom and bank chest at Fossil Island's Museum Camp.
CRAFTING.name: Crafting drift nets

CRAFTING.about: Golem crafting is a Crafting training method located on the island of Wyrmscraig that serves as an alternative to glassblowing at higher levels.
CRAFTING.name: Golem Crafting

CRAFTING.about: Players who have 77 Magic (can be boosted) and have completed Lunar Diplomacy, which requires 61 Crafting along with other requirements (cannot boost from lower levels to complete), can cast Superglass Make with the lunar spellbook.
CRAFTING.name: Casting Superglass Make

CRAFTING.about: Lamps can be fixed in Dorgesh-Kaan for both Crafting and Firemaking experience. This requires completion of The Lost Tribe and level 52 Crafting and Firemaking. Each lamp requires a light orb to fix.
CRAFTING.name: Fixing goblin lamps in Dorgesh-Kaan

CRAFTING.about: Cutting amethyst into ranging material with a chisel will often yield very small losses (or even profits) while also granting more experience than glassblowing, making it a viable method for those who are willing to sacrifice the speed of other methods for cheaper (or profitable) Crafting experience.
CRAFTING.name: Cutting amethyst

DEFENCE.about: As discussed in the above early questing section, completing quests is the fastest method to skip through the early levels. These quests will level a player to level 45 Attack, level 34 Strength, and level 31 Defence without any direct training.
DEFENCE.name: Questing

FARMING.about: Early levels can be skipped by completing quests that give Farming experience. Completing the Goblin generals subquest of Recipe for Disaster, Fairytale I - Growing Pains, Forgettable Tale...
FARMING.name: Questing

FARMING.about: The fastest way to train the early levels is to plant bagged plants in the player-owned house. However, it is significantly more expensive than planting seeds.
FARMING.name: Bagged plants

FARMING.about: Another option to train the early levels is to make supercompost or ultracompost in a compost bin. Each bucket of supercompost grants 8.5 farming experience, or 10 experience with the addition of volcanic ash to produce ultracompost.
FARMING.name: Making supercompost/ultracompost

FARMING.about: In the Sorceress's Garden minigame, players can pick sq'irk fruits or herbs from the gardens. No Thieving level is required, but a higher Thieving level increases Thieving experience rates.
FARMING.name: Sorceress's garden

FARMING.about: Tree runs are the most effective way to gain Farming experience. To do this, plant the highest-tier tree, fruit tree, and hardwood tree saplings available, along with the special tree saplings (calquat, celastrus, crystal, and redwood).
FARMING.name: Tree runs

FIREMAKING.about: 1-tick creating pyre logs offers the fastest experience up to level 30. Pyre logs can be created without tick delay by holding down 1 or space and rapidly using sacred oil on logs. This requires completion of the Shades of Mort'ton quest.
FIREMAKING.name: Creating pyre logs

FIREMAKING.about: Burning logs is one of the fastest ways to train Firemaking. The best place to do this is at the eastern part of the Grand Exchange. The area has a lot of empty space and the bank is only one tile away from an area a log can be burned.
FIREMAKING.name: Burning logs

FIREMAKING.about: Burning logs on a forester's campfire is a low-effort alternative to the faster methods. Choose a location where a campfire can be lit right next to a bank, such as the Grand Exchange, Rogues' Den, or the Crafting Guild.
FIREMAKING.name: Burning logs on a campfire

FIREMAKING.about: Subduing Wintertodt from level 50 Firemaking onwards is a slower, but profitable and low-effort alternative to burning logs.
FIREMAKING.name: Wintertodt

FISHING.about: Early levels can be skipped by completing quests that give Fishing experience. Completing Sea Slug, Fishing Contest, and the Freeing Pirate Pete quest of Recipe for Disaster will grant a total of 10,612 experience, which will get the player up to level 27.
FISHING.name: Questing

FISHING.about: 3-tick fly fishing trout and salmon offers the fastest Fishing experience up to level 58 when using tick manipulation. Players will need a fly fishing rod and feathers to catch the fish.
FISHING.name: Fly fishing

FISHING.about: Drift net fishing is the most efficient way to train both Fishing and Hunter at the same time. However, it is not the fastest way to train Fishing on its own due to the split rates.
FISHING.name: Drift net fishing

FISHING.about: 3-tick Barbarian Fishing becomes one of the fastest training methods at level 58. This method offers small amounts of passive Agility and Strength experience, which makes it an efficient way to train Fishing for players with low Agility and Strength levels.
FISHING.name: Barbarian Fishing

FISHING.about: 2-tick harpooning swordfish and tuna offers the fastest Fishing experience. Lure two rats west of the Port Piscarilius bank so that they attack the player every two ticks. Equip a shortbow without ammo and turn on Auto Retaliate.
FISHING.name: 2-tick harpooning swordfish/tuna

FISHING.about: Leechfin fishing is a high-intensity training method that offers competitive experience rates, sitting between 3-tick barbarian fishing and 2-tick harpooning swordfish/tuna.
FISHING.name: Leechfin Fishing

FISHING.about: Fighting the Tempoross on mass worlds offers relatively fast experience and requires fairly low amount of effort compared to the tick manipulation methods.
FISHING.name: Tempoross

FISHING.about: Aerial fishing is a viable alternative method to train both Fishing and Hunter, offering similar experience to drift net fishing, but without the extra requirement of needing to supply drift nets.
FISHING.name: Aerial fishing

FISHING.about: Catching monkfish at the Piscatoris Fishing Colony is a profitable low-effort alternative to the faster methods. This method requires completion of Swan Song. Monkfish are caught with a small fishing net.
FISHING.name: Monkfish

FISHING.about: Catching karambwan is a profitable low-effort alternative to the faster methods.
FISHING.name: Karambwan

FISHING.about: at a nearby trawling shoal to catch fish]]
FISHING.name: Deep sea trawling

FISHING.about: Catching infernal eels in the inner part of Mor Ul Rek is a profitable low-effort alternative to the faster methods. To gain access to the area, the player must show a fire cape to a TzHaar-Ket guard (this does not consume the cape).
FISHING.name: Infernal eel

FISHING.about: Catching minnows offers relatively slow experience, but it can provide decent profit depending on the Grand Exchange price of raw sharks.
FISHING.name: Minnows

FISHING.about: At level 82 Fishing, you can start catching anglerfish in Port Piscarilius. In order to catch anglerfish, sandworms and a fishing rod are required. Sandworms can be purchased from Tynan's Fishing Supplies nearby or the Grand Exchange.
FISHING.name: Anglerfish

FISHING.about: Catching dark crabs inside the Resource Area becomes a viable low-effort option after completing the elite Wilderness Diary. The diary reward increases the catch rate for dark crabs significantly and provides the player free access to the Resource Area.
FISHING.name: Dark crabs

FISHING.about: At level 87 and after partially completing Regicide, catching sacred eels at Zul-Andra becomes a profitable low-effort alternative to the faster methods. Sacred eels are caught with a fishing rod and fishing bait.
FISHING.name: Sacred eel

FLETCHING.about: A profitable way of training Fletching is to fletch headless arrows using arrow shafts and feathers. This grants 15 experience per action, for 1 experience per headless arrow fletched.
FLETCHING.name: Headless arrows

FLETCHING.about: The best way to get from level 1 to level 5 is by fletching arrow shafts, which give 5 experience per log.
FLETCHING.name: Arrow shafts

FLETCHING.about: Making bows is a slower, less intensive method of training fletching that is usually cheap or profitable. Fletching unstrung bows is more AFK-able but yields less experience per hour, stringing bows is faster but requires paying more attention.
FLETCHING.name: Bows

FLETCHING.about: Fletching battlestaves requires one piece of Celastrus bark, and yields 80 experience per bark. Only level 40 is needed to fletch a battlestaff, which makes it a better training method than fletching bows in this level range, but can be more costly.
FLETCHING.name: Battlestaves

FLETCHING.about: Redwood shields are an alternative method to fletching bows. Fletching one shield requires two redwood logs, and gives 216 experience per shield. With a Fletching knife, the XP rates increase substantially.
FLETCHING.name: Redwood shields

HERBLORE.about: The most efficient way to gain Herblore experience is to make potions by combining base and secondary ingredients.
HERBLORE.name: Making potions

HERBLORE.about: An alternative, potentially cheaper method of training Herblore is making tar. This requires fewer clicks than potion making, since twice as many actions are performed before banking and the duration of each action is longer.
HERBLORE.name: Making tar

HERBLORE.about: An alternative, less click-intensive method, is to use the degrime Arceuus spell, requiring 70 Magic and the completion of A Kingdom Divided to be cast. You can cast approximately 600 casts per hour (47-50k magic xp/h), while potentially making profit.
HERBLORE.name: Degrime

HERBLORE.about: A medium-intensity but profitable way to train Herblore is to make Guthix rest, requiring 18 Herblore and partial completion of the One Small Favour quest.
HERBLORE.name: Making Guthix rest

HERBLORE.about: At level 60 and with completion of Children of the Sun, players can go to Aldarin and take part in the Mastering Mixology minigame, however it will become more efficient at higher levels, with the last unlock at level 81 Herblore.
HERBLORE.name: Mastering Mixology

HITPOINTS.about: As discussed in the above early questing section, completing quests is the fastest method to skip through the early levels. These quests will level a player to level 45 Attack, level 34 Strength, and level 31 Defence without any direct training.
HITPOINTS.name: Questing

HUNTER.about: Completing the Natural History Quiz in Varrock Museum grants the player 1,000 experience, which will get the player from level 1 to 9. To start the quiz, speak to Orlando Smith, located in the basement of the museum.
HUNTER.name: Natural History Quiz

HUNTER.about: Bird house trapping is a recurring Hunter training method, much like Farming. To do a bird house run, set up bird house traps on Fossil Island and fill them with suitable seeds.
HUNTER.name: Bird house trapping

HUNTER.about: Drift net fishing is the most efficient way to train both Hunter and Fishing at the same time. However, it is not the fastest way to train Hunter on its own due to the split rates.
HUNTER.name: Drift net fishing

HUNTER.about: From level 9 to 15, catch feldip weasels in the Feldip Hunter area. To quickly get there, use a Feldip Hills teleport scroll and run south near to the dungeon icon.
HUNTER.name: Feldip weasels

HUNTER.about: From level 15 to 21, catch ruby harvests while trapping copper longtails at the Piscatoris hunter area.
HUNTER.name: Ruby harvests

HUNTER.about: Requires partial completion of Pandemonium and 10 Construction to build the crab traps.
HUNTER.name: Red crabs

HUNTER.about: Requires partial completion of the Eagles' Peak quest to be able to set box traps.
HUNTER.name: Embertailed jerboas

HUNTER.about: From level 43 to 49, catch spotted kebbits (and dark kebbits at level 57) using the falconry technique. To do this, enter the Piscatoris falconry area east of the fairy ring  and rent a gyr falcon for 500 coins.
HUNTER.name: Falconry

HUNTER.about: From the level 49 to 73, catch razor-backed kebbits at the Piscatoris hunter area. Use the fairy ring  and head east. Just before the falconry there are bushes and burrows where the kebbits hide. Equip a noose wand and a ring of pursuit.
HUNTER.name: Razor-backed kebbits

HUNTER.about: Players can choose to complete Hunters' Rumours assigned by Guild hunters in the Hunter Guild. Guild hunters will tell the player to investigate about a specific hunter creature, which the player needs to hunt until a rare creature part is dropped.
HUNTER.name: Hunters' Rumours

HUNTER.about: Requires partial completion of the Eagles' Peak quest to be able to set box traps.
HUNTER.name: Black chinchompas

HUNTER.about: From level 25 to 39, equip a butterfly net and catch sapphire glacialis. These can be found in a few areas.
HUNTER.name: Sapphire glacialis

HUNTER.about: Aerial Fishing on Molch Island provides split experience between Hunter and Fishing, and also gives some passive Cooking experience as well. The activity becomes available at level 43 Fishing and level 35 Hunter.
HUNTER.name: Aerial fishing

HUNTER.about: At levels 37 to 43 players can catch swamp lizards north-west of Slepe. Trapping lizards is less click intensive than box traps. You need a rope and small fishing net for each trap.
HUNTER.name: Swamp lizards

HUNTER.about: Catching orange salamanders is a slower but less click-intensive alternative to falconry.
HUNTER.name: Orange salamanders

HUNTER.about: Maniacal monkeys are a low-effort alternative to the faster training methods, requiring interaction once every 25–30 seconds. To catch them, mount a stunted demonic gorilla and set up a deadfall trap on one of the large boulders using a banana as bait.
HUNTER.name: Maniacal monkeys

HUNTER.about: From level 60 to 67, catch red salamanders south of the entrance to the Ourania Cave. Bring 5 ropes, 5 small fishing nets, and some stamina potions.
HUNTER.name: Red salamanders

HUNTER.about: From level 67 to 73, catch black salamanders in the Bone Yard Hunter area in the Wilderness. To get there, use a burning amulet teleport to the Chaos Temple and run north-east, or a games necklace teleport to the Corporeal Beast lair and run east.
HUNTER.name: Black salamanders

HUNTER.about: Capturing moonlight moths in the Northern section of the Earthbound Cavern in the ruins of Neypotzli is a click-intensive but fast way of levelling Hunter upon reaching level 75.
HUNTER.name: Moonlight moths

HUNTER.about: Trapping rainbow crabs becomes a straightforward alternative at level 77 Hunter and 64 Sailing. They reside on The Crown Jewel island located south-west of Deepfin Point.
HUNTER.name: Rainbow crabs

HUNTER.about: Requires partial completion of the Eagles' Peak quest to be able to set box traps.
HUNTER.name: Carnivorous chinchompas

HUNTER.about: Tracking the herbiboar on Fossil Island is a fairly low-effort alternative to the faster training methods. To track the herbiboar, inspect one of the starting points in the Mushroom Forest and follow the footsteps until they enter a burrow.
HUNTER.name: Herbiboar

HUNTER.about: Starting at 82 Hunter, stymphikes become a low-effort way to train the skill, with players only needing to click 3 times every 45 seconds. They are located in Vampyrium, requiring completion of The Blood Moon Rises to access.
HUNTER.name: Stymphikes

MAGIC.about: Early levels can be skipped by completing quests that give Magic experience. Completing Witch's Potion and Imp Catcher gives a total of 1,200 Magic experience, which is enough to get from level 1 to 10.
MAGIC.name: Questing

MAGIC.about: Enchanting gem-tipped bolts using the Enchant Crossbow Bolt spell is one of the fastest ways to train magic and can be done while running or doing other activities. Each cast enchants a set of 10 bolts, and is automatically done every 3 ticks for 10 sets.
MAGIC.name: Enchanting bolts

MAGIC.about: From level 7 to 21, enchant sapphire or opal jewellery by using the Lvl-1 Enchant spell. The spell can be cast manually every 3 ticks, and each cast gives 17.5 experience.
MAGIC.name: Lvl-1 Enchant

MAGIC.about: At level 21, cast Low Level Alchemy (also known as "low alching") to convert items into coins. The spell can be cast every 3 ticks, and each cast gives 31 experience.
MAGIC.name: Low Level Alchemy

MAGIC.about: Killing crabs with combat spells requires very little attention and offers relatively fast experience at lower levels. Use the highest-level combat spell available for the best damage output.
MAGIC.name: Killing crabs

MAGIC.about: Elemental weaknesses increase both accuracy and damage on their corresponding elemental spell by a certain percentage, and commonly-accessible monsters have up to 100% elemental weakness.
MAGIC.name: Exploiting elemental weaknesses

MAGIC.about: Splashing combat spells on weak monsters offers very slow experience, but only requires player input once every 20 minutes. To splash, attack an NPC while wearing equipment that gives at least -64 Magic attack bonus.
MAGIC.name: Splashing combat spells

MAGIC.about: This minigame, which involves finding and delivering the requested books to characters in the Arceuus Library, offers fantastic experience rates without spending any runes.
MAGIC.name: Grand Library of Great Kourend

MAGIC.about: From level 43 to 55, one possible option is to cast Superheat Item to smelt ores into bars. The spell can be cast every 3 ticks, and each cast gives 53 Magic experience.
MAGIC.name: Superheat Item

MAGIC.about: Repeatedly casting Camelot Teleport offers around 80,000 experience per hour, with 55.5 experience per cast. Training from level 45 to 55 requires a total of 1,895 law runes, which costs  assuming a staff of air is equipped.
MAGIC.name: Camelot Teleport

MAGIC.about: At level 55, cast High Level Alchemy (commonly known as "alching") to convert various items into coins. The spell can be cast every 5 ticks, and each cast gives 65 experience.
MAGIC.name: High Level Alchemy

MAGIC.about: Completion of the quest Lunar Diplomacy is required to cast Bake Pie.
MAGIC.name: Bake Pie

MAGIC.about: Completion of the quest Lunar Diplomacy is required to cast Magic Imbue.
MAGIC.name: Magic Imbue

MAGIC.about: After completing the Desert Treasure I quest, the player unlocks Ancient Magicks. The burst and barrage spells on this spellbook can be used to kill multiple monsters at once in multi-combat areas.
MAGIC.name: Bursting/barraging on Ancient Magicks

MAGIC.about: Starting at level 71 Magic, or as early as level 65 with access to boosts, casting Cure Me from the Lunar spellbook can achieve up to 414,000 experience per hour optimally, costing  per hour, not including Prayer potions.
MAGIC.name: Cure Me

MAGIC.about: Starting at level 81 Magic, or earlier with access to boosts, casting Stat Restore Pot Share from the Lunar spellbook can achieve up to around 140,000 experience per hour optimally, costing  per hour, assuming a Mud battlestaff or similar is used to save runes.
MAGIC.name: Potion share

MAGIC.about: Casting String Jewellery on the Lunar spellbook requires relatively low amount of effort. The spell takes 1.8 seconds per amulet strung, or 48.6 seconds for an inventory, and gives 4 Crafting experience and 83 Magic experience per amulet.
MAGIC.name: String Jewellery

MAGIC.about: Completion of the quest Dream Mentor is required to cast Plank Make.
MAGIC.name: Plank Make

MAGIC.about: While it may be beneficial to find a consistent money maker and then train Magic with the faster but more expensive methods, it is possible to train magic without any loss.
MAGIC.name: Profitable methods

MAGIC.about: "Tele-alching" is a method which combines the two elements of casting High Level Alchemy and teleporting. To do this, cast High Level Alchemy followed by any teleport then wait 3 game ticks (1.8 seconds).
MAGIC.name: Tele-alching

MAGIC.about: At level 80 Magic, Stun-alching becomes available, but does cost much more than high alchemy which is generally profitable or free. The player is to cast High Alchemy, then cast Stun on an NPC, and repeat until desired.
MAGIC.name: Stun-alching

MINING.about: Early levels can be skipped by completing quests that give Mining experience. Completing Doric's Quest, The Dig Site, Plague City, The Giant Dwarf, The Lost Tribe and Another Slice of H.A.M.
MINING.name: Questing

MINING.about: From level 1 to 15, mine copper or tin. This can be done anywhere, though the Lumbridge Swamp mining site is debatably the easiest due to its relative lack of players and aggressive monsters, and its collection of copper and tin rocks.
MINING.name: Copper/Tin ore

MINING.about: From level 15 to 45, mine iron. Players who are inexperienced with tick manipulation methods, or do not plan to use tick manipulation at all, are advised to mine iron up to level 70 and continuing with other methods such as the Volcanic Mine.
MINING.name: Iron ore

MINING.about: 3-tick mining granite (commonly referred to as "3t4g", 3-tick 4 granite) at the quarry or Cape Conch mine offers the fastest Mining experience from level 45 onwards.
MINING.name: Granite

MINING.about: Mining in the Motherlode Mine is a profitable low-effort alternative to the faster methods. To do this, mine ore veins inside the mine, deposit the pay-dirt into the hopper to clean it, and repeat. Once the sack is full, empty it and bank the ores for profit.
MINING.name: Motherlode Mine

MINING.about: Mining gem rocks is a profitable alternative that offers comparable experience rates to granite when using tick manipulation. Gem rocks are also the fastest method on average to obtain the rock golem pet.
MINING.name: Gem rocks

MINING.about: Mining calcified rocks in the Cam Torum Mine is a low-effort alternative to the faster methods. This method requires having started Perilous Moons. The rocks deplete after around 70 seconds.
MINING.name: Calcified rocks

MINING.about: Mining rubium rocks in the Charred Dungeon offers a low-effort and profitable, but slower alternative for players wishing to avoid tick manipulation.
MINING.name: Rubium rocks

MINING.about: Mining crashed stars is a very low-effort alternative to the faster methods. As part of the Shooting Stars Distraction and Diversion, a shooting star will fall at a random spot selected from a predetermined list.
MINING.name: Crashed stars

MINING.about: Lead rocks can be found within Deepfin Mine, accessible with level 67 Sailing.
MINING.name: Lead rocks

MINING.about: The Volcanic Mine minigame on Fossil Island is a fairly low-effort alternative that offers relatively fast experience. In the mine, the goal is to mine the boulder to obtain ore fragments for Petrified Pete while keeping the mine stable.
MINING.name: Volcanic Mine

MINING.about: Zalcano is a demon imprisoned beneath Prifddinas that is fought using skilling rather than conventional combat.
MINING.name: Zalcano

MINING.about: The Blast Mine minigame is a profitable alternative that offers fast experience. At level 75, players are able to obtain runite which makes the bulk of the profit gained.
MINING.name: Blast Mine

MINING.about: Infernal shale can be mined in the Chasm of Fire with level 78 Mining. It is crushed into crushed infernal shale with a hammer and a chisel, which is used to create oathplate armour. A Kingdom Divided is required to mine the rocks.
MINING.name: Infernal shale

MINING.about: Amethyst crystals are an alternative choice for players looking to mine with low effort or click intensity, albeit for very slow experience rates.
MINING.name: Amethyst

PRAYER.about: Cremating urium remains only rewards 35,000 Prayer experience per hour (or up to to 57,000 Prayer experience per hour with Hard Morytania Diary and max efficiency), but it is the fastest way to obtain the zealot's robes.
PRAYER.name: Cremating urium remains

PRAYER.about: The fastest way to train Prayer is to offer bones at a gilded altar in a player-owned house. When both incense burners are lit, the altar gives 350% experience per bone when a bone is offered at it.
PRAYER.name: Offering bones at a gilded altar

PRAYER.about: Requiring level 30 Prayer, offering blessed bone shards to the libation bowl within the Teomat is slightly slower, but offers more experience per bone compared to the gilded altar.
PRAYER.name: Offering blessed bone shards to the libation bowl

PRAYER.about: Offering bones at the altar within the Wilderness' Chaos Temple is a slightly slower but much cheaper alternative to the gilded altar in a POH.
PRAYER.name: Offering bones at the Chaos Temple

PRAYER.about: Reanimating ensouled heads and killing the reanimated monsters near the Dark Altar is a relatively slow training method, but it requires less effort than manually offering bones at a gilded altar or the Chaos altar.
PRAYER.name: Reanimating ensouled heads

PRAYER.about: With the upgraded Arceuus spellbook from A Kingdom Divided, players can offer bones or demonic ashes from their inventory, offering simultaneous Magic experience.
PRAYER.name: Offering spells

PRAYER.about: Worshiping the Ectofuntus gives 400% the normal experience. Although this is the second-highest guaranteed per-bone prayer bonus in the game, this is much less than the 700% theoretical average experience at the Chaos Altar.
PRAYER.name: Offering bones at the Ectofuntus

PRAYER.about: With the bonecrusher or bonecrusher necklace, when charged with ecto-tokens, if the player kills a monster that drops bones, the bonecrusher will automatically crush them, granting the player half the Prayer experience they would have received from burying the bones themselves, or full amount of experience if the elite Morytania Diary is completed, and consuming one charge.
PRAYER.name: Bonecrusher

PRAYER.about: With the ash sanctifier, when charged with death runes, if the player kills a monster that drops ashes, the sanctifier will automatically scatter them, granting the player half the Prayer experience they would have received from scattering the ashes themselves, or full amount of experience if the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is completed, and consuming one charge.
PRAYER.name: Ash sanctifier

PRAYER.about: With the ectoplasmator, if the player kills a spectral creature such as an aberrant spectre, the player receives Prayer experience equal to 20% of the monster's max health, rounded down.
PRAYER.name: Ectoplasmator

PRAYER.about: Occasionally, while woodcutting or emptying Bird houses, a bird's nest containing red, green, or blue bird's eggs can be obtained.
PRAYER.name: Bird's eggs

RANGED.about: Early levels can be skipped by completing quests that give Ranged experience.
RANGED.name: Questing

RANGED.about: Using the dwarf multicannon, once assembled, offers the fastest experience up to level 45. Players must have completed Dwarf Cannon quest to use and assemble their own dwarf multicannon, but there are no level requirements to assemble and use one.
RANGED.name: Using dwarf multicannon

RANGED.about: Throwing chinchompas (commonly known as "chinning") at maniacal monkeys is the fastest way to train Ranged. Maniacal monkeys are located in Kruk's Dungeon on Ape Atoll, which requires having started chapter II of Monkey Madness II to access.
RANGED.name: Chinning maniacal monkeys

RANGED.about: The Gemstone Crab is the premier idle training method for Ranged. The crab has unlimited Hitpoints, no defensive stats, stands still, only burrows once every 10 minutes and can be reengaged with two clicks.
RANGED.name: Gemstone Crab

RANGED.about: Throwing chinchompas at skeletal monkeys is only recommended for those who cannot access maniacal monkeys. Skeletal monkeys are located in the Ape Atoll Dungeon, which requires partial completion of Monkey Madness I to access.
RANGED.name: Chinning skeletal monkeys

RANGED.about: Participating at the Pest Control minigame and spending Void Knight commendation points on Ranged experience is an alternative training method at higher levels. Having a combat level of at least 100 for the veteran boat is recommended.
RANGED.name: Pest Control

RANGED.about: Using the normal customisable rumble setup in Nightmare Zone allows for 20 minutes of AFK Ranged training. After 20 minutes, the player will stop attacking the monsters and needs to interact with the client to start attacking again.
RANGED.name: Nightmare Zone

RANGED.about: Using the toxic blowpipe or the venator bow for Slayer training is not considered efficient to do, however it is an option for players who do not value gaining Melee or Magic experience and want some variety to their training.
RANGED.name: Training Ranged with Slayer

RANGED.about: As a cheaper (albeit slower) alternative to Chinning, the Venator bow can be used with Amethyst arrows to kill either Skeleton monkeys or Maniacal monkeys to get experience rates between 140,000 and 230,000 per hour.
RANGED.name: Monkeys with Venator bow

RUNECRAFT.about: Early levels can be almost completely skipped by completing quests that give Runecraft experience. This allows the player to craft lava runes or do the Guardians of the Rift minigame.
RUNECRAFT.name: Questing

RUNECRAFT.about: Making talisman tiaras is one of the fastest training methods up to level 50. It also has no quest or skill level requirements.
RUNECRAFT.name: Making talisman tiaras

RUNECRAFT.about: Lava runes are made by visiting the Fire Altar with essence and at least an equal number of earth runes. Having a binding necklace equipped ensures combination runes are crafted 100% of the time.
RUNECRAFT.name: Lava runes

RUNECRAFT.about: Crafting lava runes with essence runners offers the fastest experience from level 23 to 90. The fastest method is to have four runners run the essence while the runecrafter stands at the altar.
RUNECRAFT.name: Lava runes with runners

RUNECRAFT.about: Crafting aether runes with essence runners offers the fastest Runecraft experience from level 90 onwards. The fastest method is to have six runners run the essence while the runecrafter stands at the altar.
RUNECRAFT.name: Aether runes with runners

RUNECRAFT.about: The Guardians of the Rift minigame is an alternative way of training Runecraft. In addition to Runecraft experience, the minigame also offers passive Mining and Crafting experience.
RUNECRAFT.name: Guardians of the Rift

RUNECRAFT.about: Crafting runes at the Ourania Altar (also known as the ZMI Altar) is a profitable lower-effort alternative to lava runes. The altar can be accessed at any Runecraft level.
RUNECRAFT.name: Ourania Altar

RUNECRAFT.about: Crafting blood or soul runes in Arceuus is a profitable low-effort alternative to the faster training methods. This method also provides passive Mining and Crafting experience. Blood runes can be crafted at level 77 and soul runes at level 90.
RUNECRAFT.name: Crafting blood/soul runes in Arceuus

RUNECRAFT.about: Helping customers in the Arceuus Library is a viable Runecraft training method that has no requirements. To do this, talk to Villia or Professor Gracklebone to have them request a book.
RUNECRAFT.name: Arceuus Library

RUNECRAFT.about: Crafting other combination runes is a profitable alternative to lava runes. The methods are almost identical, only bringing different runes and talismans and/or teleporting to a different elemental altar.
RUNECRAFT.name: Other combination runes

RUNECRAFT.about: Fighting the Royal Titans and forfeiting loot to receive desiccated pages can provide competitive runecraft experience rates. The pages are untradeable and stackable, and can be converted into burnt, soaked, or soiled pages for 50 runecraft experience per page.
RUNECRAFT.name: Imbuing desiccated pages

RUNECRAFT.about: Crafting cosmic runes requires completion of the Lost City quest. Even though cosmic runes become available at level 27, it is not recommended to craft them before level 59 due to much lower profit.
RUNECRAFT.name: Double cosmic runes

RUNECRAFT.about: Crafting double astral runes can yield good profit depending on the rune prices. This method requires completion of Lunar Diplomacy.
RUNECRAFT.name: Double astral runes

RUNECRAFT.about: Even though nature runes become available at level 44, it is not recommended to craft them before level 91 due to much lower profit.
RUNECRAFT.name: Double nature runes

RUNECRAFT.about: Crafting double law runes offers a low-effort training method and can yield good profit depending on the rune prices. Players are able to craft two law runes per pure essence at level 95, and they grant 9.5 experience per pure essence used.
RUNECRAFT.name: Double law runes

RUNECRAFT.about: If you're not 99 runecrafting make sure to attach a cosmic or catalytic tiara to the Hat of the Eye. Or bring a cosmic tiara, cosmic talisman, or use the abyss as a point of entry into the altar.
RUNECRAFT.name: Aether runes

RUNECRAFT.about: Crafting wrath runes is a profitable alternative to the faster methods. This method requires completion of Dragon Slayer II. Players will also need to run past aggressive dragons, so dragonfire protection is necessary.
RUNECRAFT.name: Wrath runes

SAILING.about: While sailing, gusts of wind will appear around the sails of a boat, allowing players to trim them and receive a boost of speed.
SAILING.name: Trimming sails

SAILING.about: Courier tasks involve taking one or more pieces of cargo between ports. Completing a task by depositing its final cargo at the destination's ledger table rewards the player with Sailing experience and a stackable loot sack.
SAILING.name: Courier tasks

SAILING.about: Sea charting is a method of training Sailing by performing specific tasks across Gielinor's oceans. These tasks often require specific tools; for example, after level 12, players can complete Prying Times to obtain the crowbar for opening crates.
SAILING.name: Sea charting

SAILING.about: While sailing, you can earn passive experience interacting with random events in the ocean. These have no level requirements.
SAILING.name: Ocean encounters

SAILING.about: Barracuda Trials generally offer the fastest experience from level 30 onwards. There are three trials: The Tempor Tantrum, unlocked at level 30, The Jubbly Jive, unlocked at level 55, and The Gwenith Glide, unlocked at level 72.
SAILING.name: Barracuda trials

SAILING.about: Bounty tasks assign players a specific sea monster and require them to obtain a set number of bounty items from that creature, similarly to Hunters' Rumours.
SAILING.name: Bounty tasks

SAILING.about: Salvaging is a low-intensity gathering activity which involves sailing to sunken shipwrecks across the ocean and using a salvaging hook to collect resources from them.
SAILING.name: Shipwreck salvaging

SAILING.about: at a nearby trawling shoal to catch fish]]
SAILING.name: Deep sea trawling

SAILING.about: A crystal extractor can be built in a facility spot on your boat at 73 Sailing and 67 Construction. Its purpose is to generate wind motes for a wind catcher or gale catcher, which is useful for high level Barracuda Trials.
SAILING.name: Crystal extractor

SMITHING.about: Early levels can be skipped by completing quests that give Smithing experience.
SMITHING.name: Questing

SMITHING.about: From level 1 to 40, smith various items at the anvil just south of the west Varrock bank. Make the highest-level item available for the fastest experience rates.
SMITHING.name: Anvil smithing

SMITHING.about: Smelting gold bars at the Blast Furnace becomes the fastest viable training method at level 40. This method costs money, and it can be fairly expensive depending on the Grand Exchange prices.
SMITHING.name: Blast Furnace gold bars

SMITHING.about: Forging swords at the Giants' Foundry minigame is a lower-effort alternative to the faster methods. This method requires completion of Sleeping Giants.
SMITHING.name: Giants' Foundry

SMITHING.about: Smelting bars (other than gold or silver) at the Blast Furnace offers slow experience, but it usually provides decent profit. Having the ice gloves and coal bag is strongly recommended to significantly increase the number of bars created per hour.
SMITHING.name: Blast Furnace

SMITHING.about: Smithing dart tips and nails offers slow experience, but it requires little attention. This method usually breaks even or makes a small profit due to their high demand. The player must have completed The Tourist Trap quest to be able to smith dart tips.
SMITHING.name: Smithing dart tips and nails

SMITHING.about: Smithing steel cannonballs offers even slower experience than dart tips, but requires even less attention, and usually makes a profit. 4 cannonballs are created per steel bar; a double ammo mould smelts two steel bars at once, doubling the experience rates.
SMITHING.name: Smithing steel cannonballs

SMITHING.about: Smithing armour at an anvil is only recommended for account builds that cannot get goldsmith gauntlets.
SMITHING.name: Smithing armour

SMITHING.about: Smithing rune platelegs, plateskirts, or 2h swords at an anvil offers decent experience, and it is also profitable.
SMITHING.name: Smithing 3-bar rune items

STRENGTH.about: As discussed in the above early questing section, completing quests is the fastest method to skip through the early levels. These quests will level a player to level 45 Attack, level 34 Strength, and level 31 Defence without any direct training.
STRENGTH.name: Questing

THIEVING.about: Early levels can be skipped by completing quests that give Thieving experience. Completing Biohazard, Hazeel Cult, Fight Arena, Tower of Life, and Tribal Totem grants a total of 7,200 experience, which will get the player from level 1 to 24.
THIEVING.name: Questing

THIEVING.about: From level 1 to 45, you can train Thieving in the Chambers of Xeric raid atop Mount Quidamortem in the Kebos Lowlands. Bring a lockpick (can obtain from a Scavenger inside the raid), then reload the raid until the first room is a thieving room.
THIEVING.name: Chambers of Xeric thieving room

THIEVING.about: Stealing from chests in Aldarin villas offers the fastest experience from level 36 until 45. Each chest gives 200 experience per successful unlock. There is a chance on failure to be teleported outside. Bring a lockpick and some stamina or super energy potions.
THIEVING.name: Chests in Aldarin Villas

THIEVING.about: Blackjacking bandits in Pollnivneach offers the fastest experience from level 45 to 49, and then from level 65 to 84. To blackjack, lure a bandit to an empty house where the other bandits cannot see them.
THIEVING.name: Blackjacking

THIEVING.about: Stealing artefacts in Port Piscarilius offers the fastest experience from level 49 to 65.
THIEVING.name: Stealing artefacts

THIEVING.about: Stealing from Rogues' Castle chests in the Wilderness offers the fastest Thieving experience from level 84 onwards. Because the chests are located in the deep Wilderness in a multi-combat zone, it is recommended to minimise the risk to player killers.
THIEVING.name: Stealing from Rogues' Castle chests

THIEVING.about: The Pyramid Plunder minigame offers the fastest Thieving experience outside of the Wilderness from level 91 onwards.
THIEVING.name: Pyramid Plunder

THIEVING.about: From level 1 to 5, pickpocket men or women around Gielinor. Players who have their respawn point in Lumbridge can do so around Lumbridge Castle and simply die to regain Hitpoints.
THIEVING.name: Men/Women

THIEVING.about: A single door in East Ardougne can be repeatedly pick-locked at level 1, rewarding 3.8 experience each success. Failing to pick-lock has no consequences, and a lockpick is not required.
THIEVING.name: Door pick-locking

THIEVING.about: From level 5 to 25, steal from the eastern bakery stall in East Ardougne market. Stand under the baker to avoid getting caught by the guards, and drop the loot. Players can gain up to 19,200 experience per hour.
THIEVING.name: Bakery stalls

THIEVING.about: From level 25 to 50, steal from fruit stalls in Hosidius. The best place to do this is in the easternmost house near the beach (see the map), which has 2 stalls close to each other and no guard dogs patrolling nearby.
THIEVING.name: Fruit stalls

THIEVING.about: Stealing valuables in Civitas illa Fortis is a low-effort alternative to the faster methods, allowing for significant AFK time. This method requires level 50 Thieving and completion of Children of the Sun. A chisel is optional to break down some of the loot.
THIEVING.name: Stealing valuables in Varlamore

THIEVING.about: With the completion of Bone Voyage and access to the Fossil Island, Underwater Agility and Thieving (also known as "swimming") becomes available.
THIEVING.name: Underwater

THIEVING.about: Pickpocketing Knights of Ardougne is a slower but more straightforward alternative to the faster training methods. A knight can be lured so that the player can continuously pickpocket them without moving the mouse.
THIEVING.name: Knights of Ardougne

THIEVING.about: Stealing from the rich chests in Dorgesh-Kaan is a fairly low-effort alternative that offers decent experience. Enter one of the two houses in Dorgesh-Kaan that contain two rich chests.
THIEVING.name: Dorgesh-Kaan rich chests

THIEVING.about: The Sorceress's Garden minigame consists of navigating through a maze while avoiding guardians to pick fruit and squeeze them into juice. A pestle and mortar is used to squeeze the fruit into juice and a beer glass is used to hold the squeezed juice.
THIEVING.name: Sorceress's Garden

THIEVING.about: Pickpocketing vyres at level 82 with rogue equipment, dodgy necklaces, and the hard Ardougne Diary completed will get 120,000–180,000 experience per hour and profit  coins per hour, depending on Thieving level.
THIEVING.name: Pickpocketing vyres

THIEVING.about: Pickpocketing elves in Prifddinas is a slower but profitable alternative after completing Song of the Elves. The elves in Prifddinas yield enhanced crystal teleport seeds which can be sold for high profit.
THIEVING.name: Pickpocketing elves

THIEVING.about: With 50 Sailing, players can steal from the stalls in Port Roberts. Unlike regular stalls, these stalls do not deplete when players steal from them, and as such will be stolen from repeatedly when clicked once.
THIEVING.name: Stealing from Port Roberts stalls

THIEVING.about: At level 94 and after completing the hard Ardougne Diary, players can pickpocket Master Farmers at 100% success rate. They yield ranarr and snapdragon seeds, which can be sold for significant profit.
THIEVING.name: Master Farmers

THIEVING.about: is trapped in this alcove (with the Shove special attack) and cannot move north.]]
THIEVING.name: TzHaar-Hur

WOODCUTTING.about: Completing Monk's Friend, Enlightened Journey, Icthlarin's Little Helper, and the Skrach Uglogwee subquest of Recipe for Disaster grants a total of 9,000 experience. This will get the player from level 1 to 26.
WOODCUTTING.name: Questing

WOODCUTTING.about: From level 1 to 15, the player should cut regular trees. Each log gives 25 Woodcutting experience. 97 logs are required to reach level 15.
WOODCUTTING.name: Regular trees

WOODCUTTING.about: From level 15 to 35, the player should cut oak trees. Each log gives 37.5 Woodcutting experience. 534 logs are required to reach level 35.
WOODCUTTING.name: Oak trees

WOODCUTTING.about: Cutting teak trees offers the fastest Woodcutting experience in the game when using tick manipulation. If the player is not using any sort of tick manipulation, cutting teak trees offers the fastest experience only up to level 65.
WOODCUTTING.name: Teak trees

WOODCUTTING.about: Cutting the blisterwood tree in Darkmeyer becomes a viable low-effort alternative at level 62. To access the tree in Darkmeyer, players must have partially completed Sins of the Father.
WOODCUTTING.name: Blisterwood tree

WOODCUTTING.about: Cutting sulliuscep mushroom trees on Fossil Island is a low-effort alternative that offers fast experience without using tick manipulation. Sulliusceps are located in the Tar Swamp, which is in the south-western part of the island.
WOODCUTTING.name: Sulliuscep

WOODCUTTING.about: After completion of The Blood Moon Rises, players can cut Bloodwood trees in Vampyrium, gaining around 130,000-210,000 experience per hour when cutting three trees at a time with a Dragon felling axe.
WOODCUTTING.name: Bloodwood trees

WOODCUTTING.about: With 72 Sailing players can cut Ironwood trees on Sunbleak island gaining around 80,000 experience per hour with a dragon axe. This increases beyond 110,000 experience per hour with a crystal felling axe and Forester's rations.
WOODCUTTING.name: Ironwood trees

WOODCUTTING.about: Cutting redwood trees in the Woodcutting Guild requires very little attention and offers decent experience. Players can bank the logs in the nearby bank chest. It is faster to simply drop the logs for the best experience rates.
WOODCUTTING.name: Redwood trees

WOODCUTTING.about: Cutting rosewood trees is a very low-effort alternative to the faster methods. They are located on Drumstick Isle, which requires level 79 Sailing to access (not boostable). A rosewood tree takes around 4 minutes and 35 seconds to deplete.
WOODCUTTING.name: Rosewood trees
